author: mtmason21
quote: I can't believe I waited 13 years for this. This isn't a GTA game. The technical foundation is there, but it's clear that Rockstar has lost their identity. Every bit of the story oozes horrible female ideology. No self respecting man would find themselves in a relationship with this woman. She's so insufferable. It's almost like they're trying to convince young men to accept this kind of low value woman as some kind of "prize". No thanks. Refunding.
